title: Project Unity flagged by the DoD as a Russian disinformation platform

tellings.quote: well I got told that I was flagged as a Russian disinformation platform by the DoD apparently but they're still letting me in the country so I was flagged as Russian

plain: Jay Anderson, who runs an online show called Project Unity, says he was told that the US Department of Defense had flagged him as a Russian disinformation platform, meaning a source of deliberately false information spread for Russia. He adds, with some amusement, that he is still being let into the country. If true, it would mean the US military keeps an eye on people who talk publicly about these topics.
